cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you thank the festival team, mention who repaired the stage floor in the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One sentence each is fine. Mine's the stage repair in the rain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, beside 'made the stage safe for the dancers.'

reason: A accepts equal speech space while specifying the actual result of the repair; remove waterproof-trouser and above-ground metaphors.
